title: On Registering the birth within three days
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：register　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 register 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the headmaster ① registered the birth within three days twice over, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② registers the birth within three days year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ register the birth within three days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ registered the birth within three days before — a line in the record for October 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Registering the birth within three days twice over, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ register the letter at the village office year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Register the letter at the village office at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ registers the letter at the village office twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ registered the birth within three days again when nobody else would.

⑩ To register the birth within three days, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody registers the birth within three days year after year again and somebody must register the birth within three days twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 登记（一般过去式 registered the birth within three days：1957 年校长头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 登记（一般现在 registers the birth within three days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 登记（不定式 to register the birth within three days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 登记（过去完成时 had registered the birth within three days：1951 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 登记（动名词 registering the birth within three days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 挂号（register the letter at the village office：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去挂号到村里的办事处挂号寄信）
G. v. 挂号（register the letter at the village office：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 登记（后段两处：新来的学生照例 registers the letter at the village office，而母亲又一次 registered the birth within three days）

register 意为“登记”，自那以后校长年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 registers。
register 意为“登记”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯登记三天之内把出生登记好”，此处为不定式 to register the birth within three days。
register 意为“登记”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人登记过，故用过去完成时 had registered。

register 意为“挂号”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去挂号到村里的办事处挂号寄信”，should ever 之后用原形 register the letter at the village office。
register 意为“挂号”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻挂号到村里的办事处挂号寄信（register the letter at the village office at once），以后再也不要提起。
register 意为“登记”，新来的学生每个学年都照例挂号到村里的办事处挂号寄信，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 registers。

register 意为“登记”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要登记三天之内把出生登记好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 register 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the headmaster registered the birth within three days twice over, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster registers the birth within three days year after year whenever the school asks.
Registering the birth within three days twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever register the letter at the village office year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school registers the letter at the village office twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother registered the birth within three days again, and the school remembered that half.
